RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 30

An all-male panel is not evidence that sex influenced the outcome. It's common in senior public-sector recruitment and proves nothing on its own — plenty of such panels appoint women. Treated as your main argument, it will read as speculation and weaken you.

It does matter as context. If the panel's composition breaches your ministry's own rules on balanced selection panels, that's a concrete procedural point worth naming.

Your strongest ground right now is the silence. Two weeks without written reasons, when you're likely entitled to them, is a clear failure. Chase that formally first, in writing, with a deadline. Read the reasons before deciding whether anything else is worth raising.
